{"document": {"aggregate_severity": {"namespace": "https://www.suse.com/support/security/rating/", "text": "important"}, "category": "csaf_security_advisory", "csaf_version": "2.0", "distribution": {"text": "Copyright 2024 SUSE LLC. All rights reserved.", "tlp": {"label": "WHITE", "url": "https://www.first.org/tlp/"}}, "lang": "en", "notes": [{"category": "summary", "text": "Security update for amazon-ecs-init", "title": "Title of the patch"}, {"category": "description", "text": "This update for amazon-ecs-init fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-41178: go.opentelemetry.io/otel/baggage: no rejection of raw-length headers in baggage parsing allows for DoS
  via oversized inputs (bsc#1276744).
- CVE-2026-84303: google.golang.org/grpc: xDS RBAC HTTP filter implementation issue allows for bypass of authorization
  policies via mixed-case or canonical-case header matches (bsc#1279329).
- CVE-2026-84304: google.golang.org/grpc: heap memory exhaustion via HTTP/2 DATA frame fragmentation (bsc#1279231).

Changes for amazon-ecs-init:

- Update to version 1.107.0
 * Feature - Add MPS GPU Sharing capability (#5139)
 * Enhancement - Add MPS control daemon health gate task resource
 (#5107)
 * Enhancement - Surface MPS control-daemon impairment reason
 as StatusReason (#5125)
 * Enhancement - Attach the MPS control daemon health gate to
 MPS tasks (#5119)
 * Enhancement - Add ACCELERATED_COMPUTE health check for the
 MPS control daemon (#5124)
 * Enhancement - Fetch GPG keys from S3 instead of GitHub in
 ECS Anywhere install script (#5130)
 * Enhancement - Bump github.com/prometheus/common from 0.66.1
 to 0.71.0 in /ecs-agent (#5117)
 * Enhancement - Bump github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/credentials
 from 1.19.32 to 1.20.4 in /agent (#5128)
 * Enhancement - Bump github.com/containerd/containerd from 1.7.33
 to 1.7.35 in /ecs-init (#5133)
 * Enhancement - Bump google.golang.org/grpc from 1.82.1 to 1.83.1,
 this also updated go.opentelemetry.io/otel to v1.44.0
 in /ecs-agent, /ecs-agent/daemonimages/csidriver and /agent (#5123)
 * Enhancement - Bump k8s.io/api from 0.28.1 to 0.37.0 in /agent (#5118)
 * Enhancement - Correct broken systemd link in README (#5129)
 * Enhancement - Bump golang.org/x/text and related dependencies (#5100)
 * Enhancement - Bump github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/feature/ec2/imds
 from 1.18.33 to 1.18.38 in /ecs-agent (#5093)
 * Enhancement - Bump github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/secretsmanager
 from 1.35.2 to 1.44.7 in /agent (#5094)
 * Enhancement - Bump github.com/gorilla/websocket from 1.5.0 to 1.5.3
 (#5108)
 * Enhancement - Update Go version to 1.26.7 (#5105)
 * Enhancement - Add amazon-ecs-agent.gpg and amazon-ssm-agent.gpg
 to the CodePipeline release artifacts (#5101)
 * Enhancement - IMDS credentials scanner/refresher: Add logging
 and validations (#5091)
 * Enhancement - Bump github.com/containerd/cgroups/v3 from 3.0.4
 to 3.1.3 in /agent (#5081)
 * Enhancement - Bump google.golang.org/grpc from 1.81.1 to 1.82.1
 in /ecs-agent and /agent (#5085)
 * Enhancement - Bump github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/credentials from
 1.19.29 to 1.19.32 in /ecs-agent, /agent and /ecs-init (#5080)
 * Bugfix - fix(handlers): raise fault rate limit to 1 rps (#5092)
 * Feature - Nvidia MPS GPU sharing (not yet enabled)
 * Add MPS control-daemon health probe (#5095)
 * Add per-GPU memory accounting to host resource manager (#5090)
 * Allow MPS containers to colocate on a shared GPU (#5083)
 * Mount MPS control binary and pipe dir into the agent container
 (#5086)
 * Move MPS pipe directory to /run/mps-ecs (#5102)
 * Enhancement - Add retry for EFS volume creation to handle plugin
 timeout errors caused by concurrent mount operation (#5077)
 * Enhancement - Bump github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/config from
 1.32.23 to 1.32.31 in /agent (#5064)
 * Enhancement - Bump google.golang.org/grpc from 1.79.3 to 1.82.1
 in /ecs-agent/daemonimages/csidriver (#5056)
 * Enhancement - Bump github.com/gorilla/mux from 1.8.0 to 1.8.1
 in /ecs-agent (#5063)
 * Enhancement - add nos3readcache S3 Files mount option (#5062)
 * Add ecs.capability.gpu-sharing-mps capability for NVIDIA MPS
 GPU sharing (#5053)
 * Inject NVIDIA MPS env vars and pipe mount into MPS containers
 (#5082)
 * Map ACS GPU sharingStrategy onto the internal container model
 for MPS (#5076)
 * Gate gpu-sharing-mps on complete per-GPU memory- (#5075) (#5075)
 * Regenerate ACS model for GPU sharingStrategy and validate it (#5071)
 * Report per-GPU memory at container instance registration
 for GPU sharing (#5061)
 * Regenerate ECS SDK with gpuInfo on PlatformDevice (#5060)
